title: What is the best order to study NCERT books for UPSC Prelims?
body: I am a beginner and confused about which NCERT subject to start with. Should I go class-wise or subject-wise?

answers.body: Go subject-wise rather than class-wise. Start with History (class 6 to 12), then Geography, then Polity, and finish with Economy. This keeps each subject's narrative connected instead of jumping topics every year.
